title: Listed scalar-six coefficient maps and finite composites
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and the finite subextensions $E$ of $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with their rings of integers [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use commutative condensed ring objects [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], the finite-subextension-valued closure [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], and the bundled coefficient presentation [def-sfb-scalar-six-coefficient-interfaces]. The listed coefficient maps are the smallest class closed under finite composition and isomorphic changes of source and target ring presentations containing: (i) all homomorphisms $A\to B$ between finite discrete commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$; (ii) the inclusions $\mathcal O_E\to\mathcal O_F$ of the condensed rings of integers [def-sfb-padic-integers-condensed-ring] and $E\to F$ [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-map] of the condensed fields [def-sfb-padic-subfield-condensed-ring], for finite subextensions $E\subseteq F$; (iii) $\mathcal O_E\to E$ [def-sfb-integers-to-subfield-point] and $E\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-to-qlbar]; (iv) every continuous ring homomorphism $\mathcal O_E\to A$ to a finite discrete commutative ring killed by a power of $\ell$. Continuous rings and maps are the continuous-function construction of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], and integral/closure inclusions are the recorded constructions of [lem-sfb-common-field-lattice-generators]. No flatness condition is imposed. Finite rings may be represented by small carriers, since isomorphic ring presentations are allowed.
